text:

subject: [COMPANY] / Encord - catch up
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope you're doing well! My colleague Dillion mentioned you two connected
last year, and I wanted to check in and see how Johnson Control's AI
roadmap has evolved since then.

I know you were leaning towards Voxel51 for cost reasons - curious if,
given your recent growth, new data pipeline challenges have surfaced that
open-source tools struggle to handle. Many teams we work with have moved
from multi-tool stacks (CVAT, Voxel51, Segments, services) to Encord,
consolidating annotation, QA, and model evaluation in one platform -
reducing both cost and operational overhead.

Open to a quick catch up in the next week to explore before your contract
renewal? I'm flexible Tuesdays to Thursdays mornings.

subject: [NAME] - computer vision
text:

We've been working with teams like LVT, Flock Safety, Rhombus, and Voxel to

environments, keeping annotations consistent, and edge cases managed can be

training data quality at scale.
